articles.title: Bending Spoons to buy collaboration tools maker Miro for $1.36B, 90% less than its 2022 valuation
articles.description: Bending Spoons is buying Miro for $1.36 billion, a huge dip in valuation for the workplace collaboration startup, which was valued at $17.5 billion in late 2021.
articles.raw_content: Bending Spoons is buying Miro for $1.36 billion, a huge dip in valuation for the workplace collaboration startup, which was valued at $17.5 billion in late 2021.
articles.selection_reason: A $1.36B acquisition at 90% below peak valuation signals a major market correction in SaaS, crucial for strategic planning.
articles.audience_value: Insight into distressed asset valuations and M&A opportunities in the collaboration tools market.
articles.why_this_matters: Why this matters: At 90% off peak, this deal sets a new floor for how executives should value SaaS assets in 2026.

articles.title: The AI economy: Interconnected forces, feedback loops, and speeds of change
articles.description: AI is shaped by forces far beyond the technology itself, and its effects reach just as widely. Mapping how the pieces interact helps us see what could influence its course and where hurdles and opportunities may emerge.

articles.selection_reason: McKinsey's systemic analysis of AI's economic feedback loops is essential reading for long-term strategic planning.
